title: The Gate
subtitle: Six ways to ask whether something is true
description: Every task here is a checkmark except one, so nothing completes by
accident: each quest waits for a press, and the press is what a condition
can refuse. The supply is the exception -- an item task, where the
condition gates the counting itself. Six quests gate the task and one
gates the reward, because both halves of a quest can carry conditions and
they are asked the same way; the last file shows a criterion name that
nothing declares, which reads as not done rather than as an error.
A condition is asked per player. On a shared task that means a member who
fails it contributes nothing -- their count does not move the quest, and
in a pooled party they do not pay for it either. Party size is the one
condition with the same answer for everybody: it counts the members who
are online right now, and you count as one.
